name: Rules
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of adhering to God's rules by meditating on His law continuously and striving to obey His commandments wholeheartedly. Believers are called to submit to governing authorities as they are established by God, yet ultimately, obedience to God takes precedence over human commands. Furthermore, all actions should be done with sincere devotion as if serving the Lord, reflecting a heart aligned with His will. The presence of righteous leadership brings joy to the people, while wicked rule results in sorrow, underscoring the divine order in authority.
